recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31829 unless a future BR&R decision changes the SubstanceDefinition moiety model or revisits the FHIR-34150 element rename.
issue_request: FHIR-31829 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core BR&R clarification request for the R4 SubstanceSpecification/SubstanceDefinition moiety.amountType element. The issue said the definition was not understandable and needed a better description; the accepted applied wording explained the measurement type of the quantitative value and gave mole ratio and weight ratio as examples.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Jira comments record the expanded definition and then say "change applied". Git commits 2326b50c48 and 2ac0ae1b79 added the expanded definition to source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-34150 later renamed SubstanceDefinition.moiety.amountType to SubstanceDefinition.moiety.measurementType to avoid a peer element starting with the amount[x] choice prefix. The rename commit e04f188bdc preserved the FHIR-31829 definition text. SubstanceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and no Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already contains the accepted explanatory sentence at SubstanceDefinition.moiety.measurementType.
